method: Manual interaction through Bitrig's built-in simulator, using visible controls, keyboard input, scrolling, and accessibility observations.
overallResult: Failed checks reproduced; full coverage incomplete because simulator inspection stopped working.

environment.runtimeOSVersions: Not provided by simulator observations; SDK and deployment targets were inspected separately.

passedChecks.verified: Read all three pages using Next, then tapped Start journaling and reached Today.
Selected Wink in Today and Sad in Page. Entered and replaced notes through the software keyboard; draft status updated. The other three mood choices were visible but were not individually exercised.
Writing about a walk and family produced peaceful walk, family, grateful, and outdoors suggestions. Selecting grateful and family updated the tag count and chips.
passedChecks.limit: This verifies the suggestion UI, not whether Apple Intelligence or the existing fallback generated the suggestions.

passedChecks.verified: Save changed to disabled Saved; the note, mood, and selected tags appeared in Recent pages and a calendar sticker appeared in Page.
A downward content drag dismissed the keyboard and restored access to the tab bar. Save alone left the keyboard open.
Tapping the October 4 calendar sticker loaded the saved note into the Page editor.
Changed the saved note, chose Sad, added calm, and tapped Save page. Recent pages and Insights reflected the edit.
Wink showed zero matching pages, Sad showed the edited page, and All restored browsing without a mood restriction.
The single saved Sad entry produced Entries 1, Average 2.0, a trend point at Sad, and a Sad distribution count of 1.
With zero or one saved entry, the recap explained that at least two entries were required rather than displaying a generation failure.
Switched repeatedly among Today, Page, and Insights after dismissing the keyboard.

findings.title: Today retains stale saved state after a Page edit
steps: In Page, tap its calendar sticker, edit its note and mood, and save.
findings.expected: Today's editor displays the current saved entry when it has no unsaved changes.
findings.actual: Today still shows the original Wink mood and original note with disabled Saved, while its Recent pages card shows the edited Sad entry.
findings.risk: A subsequent Today save could replace the newer Page edit. That overwrite was not executed during this test.
findings.source: MoodMargins/Features/Today/ViewModel/TodayViewModel.swift: loadTodayIfNeeded only loads once per view-model lifecycle.

findings.title: Page starts with a template instead of today's saved entry
steps: Open Page before tapping a calendar sticker.
findings.expected: The selected date and editor agree with the saved entry, or the UI explicitly presents a separate new draft.
findings.actual: The editor shows Dear diary, and the default Laughing mood even though a saved Wink entry exists for the displayed date. Tapping its calendar sticker loads the real entry.
findings.risk: Save page can replace the entry for the displayed date with this template. The replacement behavior is inferred from the save implementation; the template overwrite was not executed.
findings.source: MoodMargins/Features/Pages/ViewModel/PageViewModel.swift: default draft values and same-day fallback save matching.
findings.status: Stale initial editor reproduced; overwrite risk identified from code.

findings.title: Dark appearance makes diary text and secondary labels unreadable
findings.expected: Readable text contrast against the diary cards and background in both appearances.
findings.actual: Diary notes become white on cream cards. Dates, status copy, insight captions, and chart dates become very faint on the fixed light backgrounds.
findings.status: Reproduced on Today and Insights; not fixed.

findings.title: Insights shows the Today heading and no range selector
steps: Open Insights and inspect the entire screen.
findings.expected: An Insights heading and a reachable control for the supported ranges.
findings.actual: The heading is Today. No range picker appears visually or in the accessibility tree; the screen remains on the 7-day range.
findings.source: InsightsView uses Header rather than the existing InsightHeader, which contains the range picker.

findings.title: Insight summaries display raw symbol names and unsupported conclusions
steps: Save a Sad entry and inspect Insights again.
findings.expected: A friendly empty state, a meaningful common-mood value, and patterns supported by the saved entries.
findings.actual: Most common displays angry.face with no entries and sad.face after the edit. The empty screen shows #calm as Top tag. Soft pattern claims outdoors pages often have Good or Great moods even with no entries or outdoors tags.

findings.title: The streak badge is static
steps: Finish onboarding on the empty simulator and inspect Today and Insights.
findings.expected: A streak derived from saved entries.
findings.actual: Both screens display 3-day streak with zero entries, and the badge remains unchanged after one save.
findings.status: Reproduced and confirmed in code; not fixed.

findings.title: Search is not reachable on the tested Page screen
steps: Open Page and inspect its header, browsing section, and accessibility tree.
findings.expected: A visible or discoverable search control for saved pages.
findings.actual: No search field or search action was available despite searchable being declared in the view.
findings.status: Control absence observed; query behavior could not be tested.

findings.title: Maximum Dynamic Type breaks labels and saved-page previews
steps: Inspect Today and scroll to Recent pages.
findings.expected: Readable controls and meaningful preview text at supported accessibility sizes.
findings.actual: Saved breaks within the word across lines. The small Recent pages card reduces the date and note to heavily truncated fragments such as Oc… and UI T….

findings.title: Selected moods and tags are not conveyed in accessibility state
steps: Select a mood and tags, then inspect their accessibility entries.
findings.expected: The selected state is available to assistive technology as well as visually.
findings.actual: The controls expose labels but no selected trait or selected-state value after selection, while their visual styling changes.
findings.status: Accessibility tree observation only; VoiceOver interaction was not completed.

findings.title: The Watch app is still a placeholder
findings.expected: Usable MoodMargins functionality on the shipped Watch target.
findings.actual: Only a globe and Hello, world! appear. There are no journaling controls.
findings.status: Reproduced; not implemented during this testing task.

inconclusiveObservations.flow: iPhone landscape with Reduce Motion enabled
inconclusiveObservations.observed: Page appeared in a narrow column with blank white side areas. Simulator inspection subsequently failed.
inconclusiveObservations.limit: The observation was not reproduced on another device; it may be a simulator rendering problem rather than an app layout defect. Reduce Motion animation behavior was not established.

Onboarding Skip and completion persistence across relaunch.

Older dates, multiple entries, larger datasets, CloudKit sync, and save-error recovery.
